tools.name: plan_meal
tools.description: Make a meal plan: each dish starts at the right moment so everything is ready at the same time. Returns a link (open it on the phone in the kitchen, where the alarms ring), a QR code for that link, and the schedule. YOU do the cooking knowledge: break a recipe into dishes, each with its total cookin

tools.name: meal_status
tools.description: Say what is next in a meal plan made with plan_meal, and how long until it. Give the plan's code (the last part of its link). Only reads; never changes a plan. Give the control key too, if you have it, to also see the timers on the phone.

tools.name: pause_meal
tools.description: Pause every dish of this plan that is running on the phone (the cook can resume on the phone or you can call resume_meal). Needs the plan's code and control key. Only works after the person has tapped Start on the phone; before that it says so.

tools.name: resume_meal
tools.description: Resume the paused dishes of this plan on the phone. Needs the plan's code and control key.

tools.name: adjust_dish
tools.description: Add time to a dish (a positive number of minutes) or take time off (negative). Before the person taps Start this changes the plan, and the ready time stays; afterwards it changes that dish's timer on the phone. Needs the plan's code and control key.

tools.name: skip_step
tools.description: Skip the rest of the current wait for one dish: a dish still waiting to go in starts now, and a dish that is cooking finishes now. Only works after the person has tapped Start on the phone. Needs the plan's code and control key.

tools.name: add_dish
tools.description: Add one more dish to this plan. The ready time stays, so the new dish goes in at the ready time minus its cooking time and must still fit. Before the person taps Start it joins the plan on the sheet; afterwards it goes onto the phone too. Same rules as plan_meal: a plain-text name, at most 12 dishes

tools.name: link_dish
tools.description: Make a dish start a while after another dish goes in or is done ("the potatoes 30 minutes after the chicken goes in"), or clear that link by leaving `after` out. Starting the other dish early or late then moves this one with it. A dish cannot wait on a dish that waits on it, and a dish that already

tools.name: cancel_meal
tools.description: Cancel this plan: its link stops working, and if the person already started it, its timers are removed from the phone. Only that plan's timers; nothing else on the phone. Needs the plan's code and control key. Ask the person first.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "plan_meal" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
